acceptanceCriteria.text: The CLI command line injected into a chat names the executable and cli.js of the running app, including a dev build started from the repository
A test covers the command line for a packaged build and a dev build
incompatible_schema from the CLI names the build path it ran and hints that a newer build owns the database

body: A card chat started from a dev build (image-attachments, schema v14) was told to run the dm CLI from the installed app (%LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs/dark-mechanicus, schema v13). Once the dev build migrated the database to v14, every CLI call failed with incompatible_schema ('Database schema v14 is newer than this build supports (v13)'), so the orchestrator could not heartbeat, claim or submit DM-420. Running the repo's own out/main/cli.js with node_modules/electron worked. The injected command line should name the executable and cli.js of the build that launched the chat.
title: Chat instructions point agents at the installed CLI, not the build that started the chat
